title: ALR hotkeys cannot be removed
prompt: This is the Alberta Law Review editing template (ALR_V1). Its ThisDocument module binds two template hotkeys (Ctrl+Shift+Q for QuickQuoteCopy and Ctrl+Shift+X for RejectThisChange_Key) through Bind_ALR_Hotkeys and is supposed to remove them through Unbind_ALR_Hotkeys. Users report that after running Unbind_ALR_Hotkeys the shortcuts still fire. Find and fix the defect so that Unbind_ALR_Hotkeys removes exactly those two bindings from the attached template's customization context while Bind_ALR_Hotkeys keeps working. Do not change the key assignments. Verify in real Word: create a document from the built template, bind, confirm the two KeyBindings exist in the template context, unbind, and confirm they are gone.
